entities.name: Gaspar Quintana Jorquera

entities.summary: Gaspar Quintana Jorquera was a Chilean Roman Catholic prelate. He was Bishop of Copiapó from 2001 to 2014. Quintana Jorquera died on 27 December 2025 at the age of 89.
